task_summary: Identify patterns and criteria for evaluating the student agent's ability to implement teacher-guided candidate revisions with explicit reasoning trajectories.
optimization_goal: Improve evidence reading order, revision scope discipline, teacher handoff quality, loop exit behavior, and candidate write-back compliance.

approval_bar: Traceable data origin: student.agent.md + teacher/trainer skill contracts
Stable version: pinned to checked-in repo file
License: project-internal, freely reusable for eval authoring

primary_sources.name: student.agent.md
primary_sources.role: Ground truth for correct student behavior, output format, and revision constraints

primary_sources.name: teacher.agent.md
primary_sources.role: Defines what teacher critique and steering artifacts look like (inputs to the student)

primary_sources.name: trainer-train-agent SKILL.md
primary_sources.role: Defines handoff behavioral requirements the student must satisfy

primary_sources.name: Existing agent workspace examples
primary_sources.role: Concrete examples of eval row shape, judge-mode selection, and workspace layout

key_behavioral_dimensions: Evidence reading order: reading STEERING.md before making any revision
Revision scope discipline: not changing out-of-scope elements (placeholders, eval shapes, constraints)
Teacher handoff trigger: only when critique is genuinely insufficient, not as a reflex
Engineer handoff trigger: only for formatting the reasoning trajectory, not for revising the candidate
Reasoning trajectory completeness: exposing plan, tradeoffs, and uncertainty
Teacher approval prediction: predicting before finalizing and self-checking if uncertain
Candidate write-back: saving revised candidate to correct workspace path
unresolved_gaps: None — the repository's existing agent skill contracts and workspace examples provide sufficient coverage for all key behavioral dimensions.
